verdict.span: **Ambiguities/scope note:** "Better error handling" is open-ended. I'll focus on the concrete gaps: raw Python tracebacks leaking to users on bad inputs (bad date, bad currency, corrupt store, bad file path), missing input validation (negative amount, unknown category, malformed `--month`), and the missing stderr/exit-code contract. I won't add validation for things the framework already handles (argparse's own type errors).
